verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages document a custom trademark extranet. It gives clients and outside counsel paperless access to trademark documents, docket management, dispute matters and auto-synchronized reporting, so the firm itself provides a client extranet covering matters, documents and status. Its documented scope is limited to the trademark practice, and the real-time budget dashboards are described as internal tools for partners and project managers. Missing for 10: any documentation of security controls (authentication, encryption, access permissions), a firm-wide portal beyond trademark matters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: Access is immediate, complete and paperless – to trademark data, documents, specimens and evidence for in-house managers and outside counsel.
Easy-to-use tabs offer full searching, reporting and docket management for complete portfolios, individual marks and dispute matters.
Contents are automatically updated and synchronized to each trademark docket for robust, easy-to-use reporting.
custom Trademark extranets for managing global portfolios
